clues: This city sits on the west coast of Sri Lanka, at the mouth of a lagoon. It lies a short way from Colombo, the great city of the land.
Most rain here rides in on the south-west monsoon winds. They blow from May to August, and then come back from October to January.
Folk here have fished these seas for hundreds of years. That old trade still shapes the life of this coast town.
Most folk here are Christian, and the town speaks two tongues. Both faith and speech set this coast town apart.
The main airport of the land lies just nine kilometres from here. This town is the big town that sits closest to it.
